newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ FUTURES END DOWN BUT OFF LOWS, OVER KEY LEVEL.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ FUTURES END DOWN BUT OFF LOWS, OVER KEY LEVEL.

text.p: FCOJ futures ended a volatile session slightly weaker but well off the lows reached earlier in the day.
Market sources blamed losses on speculative profit-taking after the benchmark October contract climbed to an eight-week high of 82.10 cents on Monday.
The trade remained notably absent from the market ahead of Thursday's private estimate of the 1997/98 Florida crop by Citrus Consulting International.
"It would be too risky for the trade to place a hedge before the number is out," a juice broker said.

September juice finished 0.55 cent lower at 81.30 cents a lb, having ranged from 82.25 to 78.20 cents. Second-month November eased 0.80 cent on the day to 83.10 cents. The rest of the board settled 0.60 to 2.40 weaker.
Analysts said the close over 80.25 cents basis September, the former resistance level that was pierced on Monday, may signal a continuation of the recent uptrend on Wednesday.
The spot month could test 83.00 cents and then retreat depending on Thursday's estimate.
An estimated 11,000 lots changed hands on the day, compared with Monday's official 9,681 lots.
